title: Surjectivity on stalks gives residue-field isomorphisms
statement: Let p : W → Z be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] whose maps on stalks are surjective. For every w ∈ W, the induced residue-field map κ(p(w)) → κ(w) [def-weil-residue-field] is an isomorphism.

proof.text: For y in κ(w), choose a representative b in the local ring O_W,w, and lift b through the surjective stalk map to a in O_Z,p(w). Compatibility of the residue-field map with the residue maps shows that the residue of a maps to y. Thus the residue-field map is surjective. A unital homomorphism of fields is injective, hence this map is bijective and is an isomorphism in CommRingCat. This is the existing, kernel-checked proof in Hom.residueFieldMap_surjective and Hom.isIso_residueFieldMap; no new Lean statement is introduced.
